allowed_evidence: official proceedings page or paper PDF
verification_policy.claim_rule: A joint gap that was not contradicted by checked sources remains unresolved; it is not verified novelty.

overall_reason: Five recorded titles are incorrect, one negative keyword claim about ReMind is false as written, three closest-neighbor mechanisms are materially under-described, and at least two high-pressure primary works were absent from the recorded source set.

claim_corrections.reported_claim: keyword checks of the arXiv HTML did not find counterfactual, causal, accept or reject terminology
claim_corrections.reason: The official full text contains causal-video-generation wording, so the literal keyword claim is false. More importantly, keyword absence would not establish a methodological absence.
claim_corrections.replacement: Method and appendix review did not identify a fixed-state intervention on one selected runtime memory source. ReMind instead uses corrupted-memory training, protected anchors, retrieval and attention or KV-importance diagnostics.

source_checks.verified_title: VMem: Consistent Interactive Video Scene Generation with Surfel-Indexed View Memory
source_checks.verified_mechanism: Indexes historical view identifiers by 3D surfels, renders query-view evidence, frequency-votes historical views, conditions the generator on selected views, and writes generated views back to memory.
source_checks.verified_boundary: Its paper-level evidence is system and module evaluation; it does not report a fixed-state intervention that estimates one selected view's total source-to-generated-region causal effect.

source_checks.verified_title: Video World Models with Long-term Spatial Memory
source_checks.verified_mechanism: Combines recent-frame working memory, a geometry-grounded static point-cloud spatial memory, and sparse historical-frame episodic memory as conditioning signals.
source_checks.verified_boundary: Component ablations do not isolate a selected source's fixed-state causal effect or localize that effect to its output support. SPMEM is the public project shorthand; the formal paper title does not visibly use it as an acronym.

source_checks.verified_title: WorldMem: Long-term Consistent World Simulation with Memory
source_checks.verified_mechanism: Stores frames with state information in memory units and consumes them with state-aware memory attention.
source_checks.verified_boundary: No fixed-state counterfactual attribution for one runtime memory unit was identified.

source_checks.verified_title: Learning World Models for Interactive Video Generation
source_checks.verified_mechanism: Motivates explicit global-state conditioning because naive long context or retrieval can be ineffective under limited in-context learning.
source_checks.verified_boundary: No runtime memory-source-to-output-region intervention was identified.

source_checks.verified_title: Context as Memory: Scene-Consistent Interactive Long Video Generation with Memory Retrieval
source_checks.venue: SIGGRAPH Asia 2025, as stated on the author project page
source_checks.verified_mechanism: Selects historical frames using field-of-view overlap and supplies them in frame-formatted context.
source_checks.verified_boundary: The checked project and paper materials do not establish single-source causal attribution or evidence acceptance.

source_checks.verified_title: Memory Forcing: Spatio-Temporal Memory for Consistent Scene Generation on Minecraft
source_checks.verified_mechanism: Shows that over-reliance on insufficient spatial context can harm novel-scene generation, then uses hybrid temporal and spatial memory training, chained forward training, geometry-indexed memory and point-to-frame retrieval.
source_checks.verified_boundary: It already treats exploration and revisit regimes differently, but does not report a per-query, fixed-state, single-source causal localization and acceptance protocol.

source_checks.verified_title: Teaching Video Generators to Remember: Eliciting Dynamic Memory for Out-of-Sight State Evolution
source_checks.verified_mechanism: Uses memory-oriented frame graphs, protected anchors, node dropping, noisy memory and reference-cache training, with PM-RoPE and non-contiguous streaming KV cache; it also studies memory or KV importance and trains on memories of differing reliability.
source_checks.verified_boundary: No fixed-state intervention estimating one selected source's generated-region causal effect was identified, but the paper is closer to reliability-aware memory use than the original summary suggests.

source_checks.verified_title: Addressable Memory for Video World Models
source_checks.verified_mechanism: Diagnoses out-of-training RoPE offsets and slot averaging as causes of unaddressable or corrupted cached content, then introduces virtual in-distribution positions and field or landmark compression.
source_checks.verified_boundary: Addressability alone does not establish source correctness, causal consumption or output localization.

source_checks.verified_title: What the DAAM: Interpreting Stable Diffusion Using Cross Attention
source_checks.verified_mechanism: Aggregates cross-attention into word-to-image spatial attribution maps and validates them against segmentation and human attribution.
source_checks.verified_boundary: This is not a causal effect estimate for a runtime image-memory source.

source_checks.verified_title: I2AM: Interpreting Image-to-Image Latent Diffusion Models via Bi-Attribution Maps
source_checks.verified_mechanism: Aggregates cross-attention across diffusion steps, heads and layers into reference-to-generated and generated-to-reference maps; SRAM maps a selected generated patch to reference patches, and the maps are evaluated against object boxes and task masks, including a random-box baseline.
source_checks.verified_boundary: It does not intervene on a reference under fixed state or estimate a causal total effect. Mask alignment, random-box comparison and attention-guided model refinement remain non-causal evidence about a runtime memory item.

source_checks.verified_title: Localizing and Editing Knowledge in Text-to-Image Generative Models
source_checks.verified_mechanism: Adapts causal mediation and causal tracing to localize concept and attribute knowledge in text-to-image components.
source_checks.verified_boundary: It does not estimate a selected runtime reference-memory source's effect on a generated region.

source_checks.verified_title: On Mechanistic Knowledge Localization in Text-to-Image Generative Models
source_checks.verified_mechanism: Shows architecture-sensitive limits of causal tracing and uses direct cross-attention-layer interventions to localize knowledge.
source_checks.verified_boundary: The intervention unit is not one selected runtime memory source and localization is not against that source's geometric output support.

source_checks.verified_title: Towards Best Practices of Activation Patching in Language Models: Metrics and Methods
source_checks.verified_mechanism: Demonstrates that corruption, restoration and metric choices materially alter localization conclusions.
source_checks.verified_boundary: This is methodological evidence for intervention controls, not a video-memory protocol.

source_checks.verified_title: Making Foresight Actionable: Repurposing Representation Alignment in World Action Models
source_checks.verified_mechanism: Performs zero, mean, shuffle and complement-swap interventions on hidden spatial tokens, measures downstream action deviation, and evaluates localization against manually annotated interaction masks with a matched sensitivity ratio, alongside robot-task success and OOD evaluation.
source_checks.verified_boundary: The target is a hidden spatial token, not a selected runtime memory item; the outcome is action deviation, not generated-video pixels; no strict item-level replay contract or prediction of natural revisit failure was identified.

source_checks.verified_title: Trust but Verify: Adaptive Conditioning for Reference-Based Diffusion Super-Resolution via Implicit Reference Correlation Modeling
source_checks.verified_mechanism: Uses summary tokens to estimate implicit low-quality-to-reference correlation and applies an online soft gate at each output token to modulate reference attention; it tests irrelevant, blurred, affine-transformed and variably matched references.
source_checks.verified_boundary: It establishes online spatial gating for one external reference, but not a fixed-state causal audit of an episodic world-memory item, a geometry-derived pre-treatment support mask, or a per-example causal score predicting natural revisit failure.

source_checks.verified_title: Sufficient Context: A New Lens on Retrieval Augmented Generation Systems
source_checks.verified_mechanism: Separates insufficient retrieved context from model failure under sufficient context and trains guided abstention.
source_checks.verified_boundary: It pressures the generic abstention abstraction but does not establish geometry-aware video evidence acceptance.

source_checks.verified_title: RECOMP: Improving Retrieval-Augmented LMs with Context Compression and Selective Augmentation
source_checks.verified_mechanism: Lets a context compressor return an empty string when retrieved information is irrelevant or unhelpful.
source_checks.verified_boundary: It does not provide a causal or geometry-aware acceptance protocol for video memory.

source_checks.verified_title: Conflict-Aware Soft Prompting for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
source_checks.verified_mechanism: Uses a context assessor and grounded or adversarial soft prompts to guide reliance on parametric versus external information under conflict.
source_checks.verified_boundary: It pressures reliability-based source selection but does not establish runtime video-memory source-to-region causality.

source_checks.verified_title: Out of Sight, Out of Mind? Evaluating State Evolution in Video World Models
source_checks.verified_mechanism: Uses observation and control interventions to evaluate state progression, plausibility and coherence while state is out of sight.
source_checks.verified_boundary: It does not identify which selected memory source caused which generated region.

source_checks.verified_title: MemoBench: Benchmarking World Modeling in Dynamically Changing Environments
source_checks.venue: arXiv preprint; author project page labels ECCV 2026 but no proceedings status was used
source_checks.verified_mechanism: Evaluates disappear-reappear consistency with visual quality, motion, identity, 3D, camera, reappearance, pixel-fidelity and VQA-related metrics.
source_checks.verified_boundary: External behavior scores do not isolate internal single-source causal consumption or acceptance.

material_omissions.title: Vision-Language Binding in In-Context Image Generation
material_omissions.why_material: It causally analyzes reference-image-to-generated-image pathways in FLUX.2 using a T2I lens, attention knockout and I2I-to-I2I activation patching, separating reference-to-text-to-image from direct reference-to-image paths.
material_omissions.remaining_difference: It is not a selected episodic memory item in a video world model, does not define one coherent intervention across every real memory-consumption path, does not evaluate against a pre-treatment geometry support and area baseline, and does not link the score to natural revisit failure or benefit.
material_omissions.required_action: Add as a closest causal-reference neighbor and run backward, forward and author citation-network checks before any novelty wording.

material_omissions.title: MosaicMem: Hybrid Spatial Memory for Controllable Video World Models
material_omissions.why_material: It lifts image patches into 3D for spatial localization and targeted retrieval, exposes a patch-and-compose interface, and supports memory-based scene editing in a controllable video world model.
material_omissions.remaining_difference: The checked primary material does not establish a fixed-state causal effect of one selected source or a natural-failure-linked acceptance score.
material_omissions.required_action: Add to the geometry-routing and source-localization neighbor set.

additional_system_neighbors.title: Compression and Retrieval: Implicit Memory Retrieval for Video World Models
additional_system_neighbors.why_relevant: Adds attention-driven viewpoint-conditioned implicit retrieval and context compression, further crowding the Select and Consume design space.

additional_system_neighbors.title: DreamX-World 1.0: A General-Purpose Interactive World Model
additional_system_neighbors.why_relevant: Uses camera-geometry memory retrieval and memory-conditioned persistence, and reports robustness mechanisms for imperfect memory latents.

closest_neighbor_scope_corrections.correction: Do not describe it as merely a heatmap. It already uses stored masks, inside-versus-outside measures, a random-box baseline and attention-guided downstream refinement. The remaining distinction is causal intervention plus geometry-derived pre-treatment support and an area-controlled effect.

Do not imply that mask comparison or performance linkage is absent. It already combines hidden-token interventions, a manual interaction mask, matched inside/background sensitivity, robot success and OOD tests. The remaining distinction is item-level memory intervention and generated-video-region outcome under strict replay.

Do not claim online or spatial reference gating as new. It already implements per-output-token soft gating and evaluates irrelevant, blurred, affine and variably matched references. The remaining distinction is causal measurement of a historical memory item and calibrated prediction of natural failures.

conditions.definition: Intervene on one actual runtime-selected memory source or item.
Hold sampling, retrieval, camera and every other relevant internal state fixed.
Change that source coherently across every real consumption path.
Localize the generated-output effect against a geometry-derived pre-treatment support and area baseline.
Show that the causal-localized quantity predicts natural failure or benefit and can support acceptance decisions.

matrix.work: Vision-Language Binding in In-Context Image Generation

five_part_gap_verification.interpretation: No checked work satisfied all five conditions jointly. This result only bounds the reviewed set. Because the source set missed high-pressure works, it cannot support a field-wide novelty claim.

required_corrections_before_reuse: Correct AGRA, Ada-RefSR, ReMind, RECOMP and CARE titles in both human-readable and machine-readable artifacts.
Replace the ReMind keyword-absence sentence with a method-level bounded statement.
Expand I2AM, AGRA and Ada-RefSR descriptions so mask baselines, causal token intervention, online spatial gating and task linkage are not presented as absent.
Add Vision-Language Binding in In-Context Image Generation and MosaicMem to the closest-neighbor matrix.
Add the two additional 2026 video-memory systems to the broader system-neighbor search.
Run backward and forward citation networks plus author-page checks for the high-pressure works.
Keep all first, novel and no-prior-work wording disabled until the expanded audit is independently repeated.
